A kit is a folder with up to eight WAV files, one file per track. Create it in the folder for your own kits: {0} Then click "Reload kits" on the Settings tab.
Order and names ‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾ The tracks follow the alphabetical order of the file names. A number at the beginning sets the order, for example "1 Crash.wav". The number is not shown, the rest of the name becomes the track name. The same applies to the folder names of the kits. You can still rename a track of your own kits later (right-click its name in the grid).
Recommended layout ‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾ So that a pattern still fits after changing the kit, all included kits are laid out like this: 1 cymbal, 2 to 4 toms or percussion, 5 open hi-hat, 6 closed hi-hat, 7 snare, 8 kick.
Preparing sounds ‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾ Any sample rate and bit depth will do, drums4me converts by itself and mixes stereo to mono. Cut off silence at the start, otherwise the hit comes too late. Shorten long decays of cymbals. drums4me stops an open hi-hat by itself as soon as another hi-hat hit follows. For this the track names must fit, for example "Hat Open" and "Hat Closed" or "Open Hihat" and "Hihat".
Organizing several kits ‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾ A folder without WAV files of its own but with kit folders forms a so-called kit collection.

data.name: Shortcuts
data.value:
Playback and tempo Space: start and stop Plus, Minus: tempo by 1 BPM Ctrl+Plus, Ctrl+Minus: tempo by 5 BPM Alt+Plus, Alt+Minus: volume by 5 %
Commands Ctrl+N: New Ctrl+O or Alt+D: File tab, Esc: back to the Home tab Ctrl+F: search projects In the project list: F2 rename, Del move to Recycle Bin, Alt+Enter properties, Ctrl+E edit in editor, Ctrl+Shift+C copy file path Ctrl+S: Save Ctrl+Shift+S: Save as Ctrl+Z: Undo Ctrl+Y: Redo Ctrl+Del: clear pattern Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V: copy and paste the marked beat, otherwise the pattern Ctrl+T: detect tempo (tap or listen) Ctrl+Comma: Settings tab F1: this overview
Mouse in the grid Right-click a step: change the strength (normal, accent, soft) Click a beat number: mark it, drag onto another: copy Ctrl + click a track switch: only this track plays Click a track name: hear the sound Right-click a track name: more options Ctrl + drag Volume or Pitch: all tracks together Double-click a control: default value Ctrl + double-click Volume or Pitch: default value for all tracks

data.name: KitsHint
data.value: Only checked kits appear in the list on the Start tab. Projects with a hidden kit still sound as usual.
